_about: Custom SFX for Engine 4 word-level audio (Phase 4). Generated once with the ElevenLabs Sound Effects API (python3 sound/sfx_fetch.py [--force name ...]) and committed as assets/sfx/<name>.mp3. A storyboard names them in `sfx` or the lexicon (sound/lexicon.ts) maps words to them; sound/build.py loads any assets/sfx/<name>.mp3 or .wav that is not in the built-in catalogue.

heartbeat.p: A slow, deep, close human heartbeat, two soft thumps then a pause, repeated, low and muffled, tense, no music

shimmer_chime.p: A bright magical shimmer chime, a rising glassy sparkle with a soft bell tail, short, clean, no music

crowd_swell.p: A distant crowd murmur swelling into a rising gasp and cheer, then fading, airy, cinematic, no words

whoosh_soft.p: A quick soft airy whoosh of a fast pass, smooth, short, clean, cinematic transition sound

box_thud.p: A cardboard pizza box dropped onto a wooden kitchen table, a dull cardboard thud with a tiny rattle, close

plate_clink.p: Three ceramic plates set down one after another on a wooden table, soft clinks, close, kitchen

clock_tick_six.p: A wall clock ticking three times and then striking a single soft chime, quiet kitchen, close

toaster_pop.p: A kitchen toaster lever springing up with a mechanical clunk and a short metallic spring pop, two slices lifting out, close, quiet kitchen

toast_sizzle.p: A hot toaster element briefly crackling and sizzling as letters are burnt into a slice of bread, a short dry sizzle and faint smoky hiss, close, no music

mug_shatter.p: A ceramic coffee mug dropping on a kitchen tile floor and breaking into a few pieces, a single sharp crack then small shards skittering, close, dry room

slice_bite.p: One crisp bite and crunch of toast in a quiet kitchen, close, dry

kettle_click.p: An electric kettle switching off with a firm plastic click and the soft tick of cooling metal, close, quiet kitchen

paper_rustle.p: A sheet of drawing paper being picked up and rustled on a kitchen fridge, one soft paper rustle, close, quiet

fridge_door.p: A kitchen fridge door opening with a soft rubber seal pull and a gentle hum, then closing with a soft thump, close, quiet room

toast_tick.p: A single crisp light tap of a butter knife on a slice of toast, dry, close, quiet kitchen

lever_clunk.p: A toaster lever being pushed down with a firm mechanical clunk and a soft latch click, close, quiet kitchen
